# Pinterest India

> A curated collection of visual inspiration spanning anime art, fashion trends, crafts, and design ideas tailored for Russian and Ukrainian-speaking audiences.

Pinterest India (in.pinterest.com) serves as a platform for discovering and sharing creative ideas across multiple categories including character art, hairstyles, nail designs, knitting patterns, and sympathy cards. The site features content in Russian and Ukrainian languages with a strong focus on anime and manga character drawings, fashion trends for 2025, and DIY craft tutorials.

## Key Topics

- Anime drawings
- Manga sketches
- Character art
- Easy sketches
- Drawing inspiration
- French manicure
- Hairstyle trends
- Knitting patterns
- Mini drawings
- Gojo Satoru
- Getou Suguru
- Tokyo Revengers
- Tattoo designs
- Doodles
- Russian content

## Anime & Manga Art

- [Чтб Аниме Рисунки](https://in.pinterest.com/ideas/чтб-аниме-рисунки/912463076083/): Anime drawing ideas collection featuring Gojo and Getou characters
- [Мини Рисункилегкие](https://in.pinterest.com/ideas/мини-рисункилегкие/951037555428/): Easy mini drawings and beginner sketches inspiration collection

## Beauty & Fashion Trends 2025

- [Стрижка Каре 2025](https://in.pinterest.com/ideas/стрижка-каре-2025/900691332084/): Bob haircut and modern hairstyle trends for 2025
- [Френч Маникюр 2025](https://in.pinterest.com/ideas/френч-маникюр-2025/924346530899/): French manicure nail design trends and inspiration for 2025

## Crafts & DIY Tutorials

- [Узоры Для Кардиганов Спицами](https://in.pinterest.com/ideas/узоры-для-кардиганов-спицами/956289123384/): Cardigan knitting patterns and stitch tutorials for needles

## Greeting Cards & Occasions

- [Соболезнования Картинки](https://in.pinterest.com/ideas/соболезнования-картинки/932638520890/): Condolence and sympathy card images in Russian and Ukrainian
